thag4.12:1.1: Pabbajiṃ jīvikattho 'haṃ, laddhāna upasampadaṃ tato saddhaṃ paṭilabhiṃ, daḷhaviriyo parakkamiṃ. || ||
thag4.12:2.1: kāmaṃ bhijjatu 'yaṃ kāyo maṃsapesī visīyaruṃ, ubhojannukasandhīhi jaṅghāyo papatantu me; || ||
thag4.12:3.1: nāsissaṃ na pivissāmi vihārā ca na nikkhame na pi passaṃ nipātessaṃ taṇhāsalle anūhate.
thag4.12:5.0: thero. Uddānaṃ: Nāgasamālo Bhagu ca Sabhiyo Nandako pi ca Jambuko Senako thero Sambhūto Rāhulo pi ca
thag4.12:6.1: bhavati Candano thero, das' ete buddhasāvakā. | Dhammiko Sappako thero Mudito cāpi te tayo. gāthāyo dve ca paññāsa therā sabbe pi terasā 'ti.
